title: Shipyard state (.ai/state.json)
description: Machine-readable project state. Written only by the coordinator; read by hooks and workflows.

status.description: Project status. BRAINSTORMING and DELIVERY_PLANNING are accepted for compatibility; the coordinator records them only as phase-log labels, because status changes only between workflows.

notesBranch.description: Local branch that holds snapshots of .ai/ (default <featureBranch>-shipyard). Written only by `shipyard_state.py snapshot`; never checked out, never merged.

formalRigour.description: C-10 formal rigour chosen at P0. Optional; absent means none.

activeRole.description: The Shipyard role the coordinator is about to delegate to. Optional. Under GitHub Copilot the hooks read it when neither SHIPYARD_ROLE nor the hook payload names the role; the coordinator sets it with `shipyard_state.py set-active-role` before each delegation and clears it with `none` afterwards.

gates.description: Human gates recorded so far, in order. Optional. Appended by `shipyard_state.py gate <P0|P4|P8|MERGE> approve --by <login>`; `at` is the ISO 8601 committer date of HEAD when the repository has a commit, else the current UTC time.
